resources.string: Shows when AutoLock is watching for you leaving the car.
AutoLock does one job: it notices when you\'ve left your unlocked Ioniq 5 and locks it for you — automatically.
When your phone disconnects from the car\'s Bluetooth, AutoLock confirms you walked away, checks the car\'s status, and locks it.
AutoLock starts in Dry run — it simulates everything but never sends a real lock. Switch to Armed in Settings when you\'re ready. Demo mode lets you try it with no account.
Next, grant the permissions AutoLock needs, then sign in and pick your car and its Bluetooth device in Settings.
